author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators wanted for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws: Anime / manga style illustrations; Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration; Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork; Semi-realistic illustrations; and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly!

author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy map designer and character illustrator wanted
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn't have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you're a fantasy author recommending someone you've personally worked with. For character art, gravitates toward realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon; book is lighter fantasy but wants grounded, lifelike art; open to different styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Portraits for now, more if the style fits the series. For the map: detailed and immersive classic fantasy-map feel, open stylistically. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites.

author: temmycreative_
title: Paid vector illustrator for Halloween apparel
content: Looking for a vector illustrator (Paid). Need an illustrator who can create an original 80s-90s Goosebumps-inspired Halloween design for a hoodie/T-shirt. Requirements: one skeleton as the main character; punk/rock retro horror vibe; clean vector for screen printing (AI/SVG/EPS); large back print (13 in x 16 in); neon green, purple and orange palette; original artwork only (no tracing existing designs). Please reply with your portfolio, turnaround time, and price.

author: Tee Yuan Xin
title: Freelance graphic designer for client campaigns
content: Looking for a Freelance Graphic Designer. Currently looking for someone who can support us on upcoming client projects, mainly for: social media visuals; ads creatives; campaign posters; simple visual adaptations / resizing. Prefer someone who has a good eye for clean and modern design, can follow brand guidelines / references well, is responsive and able to meet deadlines, and is comfortable handling ad and social media creatives. Freelance / project-based, with potential for more ongoing projects. If interested, drop your portfolio + rate in the comments or DM @yuanxin_289.
